summary.text: Lisa DeBartolomao is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Sullivan 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as retired; she says her campaign focuses on property taxes, affordable housing and education funding.

paragraphs.text: Lisa DeBartolomao earned a high school diploma from Kingswood Regional High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a native of New Hampshire with four grown children and five grandchildren, and said she serves on the Board of Trustees of the Springfield, Vermont Humane Society.
She said she edits books online for independently published authors and teaches healthy-eating classes.

DeBartolomao named three key messages in the survey: making the property tax system fairer by finding sustainable revenue sources, increasing the supply of affordable housing and helping first-time buyers, and requiring the state to fully fund public education.
